title: Exactness of inverse image
statement: Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $u^{-1}:\Ab(V_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ be the inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] between the categories of abelian sheaves on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then $u^{-1}$ is an exact functor: it commutes with finite limits and with finite colimits (Stacks Project, Categories, Definition 0034); in particular it is additive, preserves kernels and cokernels, and carries short exact sequences $0\to G'\to G\to G''\to0$ of abelian sheaves on $V_{\Et}$ to short exact sequences on $U_{\Et}$.

proof.text:
Notation. Let $b=b_u:V_{\Et}\to U_{\Et}$, $W\mapsto U\times_VW$, be the base-change functor of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits] (clause 1). For abelian presheaves let $b^p:\mathrm{PAb}(U_{\Et})\to\mathrm{PAb}(V_{\Et})$, $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F\circ b$, and let $b_p:\mathrm{PAb}(V_{\Et})\to\mathrm{PAb}(U_{\Et})$ be the presheaf pullback $b_p\mathcal G(U')=\varinjlim\mathcal G(W)$, the colimit over the pairs $(W/V,\ \varphi:U'\to U\times_VW)$ over $U$, which is left adjoint to $b^p$ by [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-left-exact] (clause 1). Let $\iota_T:\Ab(T_{\Et})\to\mathrm{PAb}(T_{\Et})$ be the inclusion and $\#$ the sheafification, left adjoint to $\iota_T$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. By [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], $(u_*F)(W)=F(U\times_VW)$, i.e. $\iota_Vu_*=b^p\iota_U$. Hence for $G\in\Ab(V_{\Et})$ and $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$, naturally in both,

$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\Ab(U_{\Et})}((b_p\iota_VG)^\#,F)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PAb}(U_{\Et})}(b_p\iota_VG,\iota_UF)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{PAb}(V_{\Et})}(\iota_VG,b^p\iota_UF)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\Ab(V_{\Et})}(G,u_*F),$$

the last because $\iota_V$ is fully faithful and $b^p\iota_UF=\iota_Vu_*F$. So $G\mapsto(b_p\iota_VG)^\#$ is a left adjoint of $u_*$; since $u^{-1}$ is by [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] the left adjoint of $u_*$, uniqueness of adjoints (Yoneda) gives a natural isomorphism $u^{-1}\cong\#\circ b_p\circ\iota_V$. This is the formula (pullback) of the source, the sheaf associated to $U'\mapsto\varinjlim_{U'\to U\times_VW}G(W)$.

proof.text: Right exactness. By [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-preserves-colimits], $u^{-1}$ preserves all small colimits, in particular finite ones: the initial (zero) object, finite coproducts (= finite direct sums) and cokernels.

source.place: Lemma 0039 (lemma-exact-adjoint, line 3510): a left adjoint is right exact; used in sites.tex Lemma 00X5 (line 2802), first sentence of the proof

proof.text: The presheaf pullback is left exact. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits] (clauses 2, 3) the category $V_{\Et}$ has finite limits (final object $V/V$, fibre products computed as scheme fibre products) and $b$ commutes with them ($b(V/V)=U/U$ is final, $b$ preserves fibre products). Hence [lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-left-exact] (clause 2), applied to $b:V_{\Et}\to U_{\Et}$, shows that the index categories of the colimits defining $b_p$ are filtered and that $b_p:\mathrm{PAb}(V_{\Et})\to\mathrm{PAb}(U_{\Et})$ commutes with finite limits; in particular, for $\varphi:\mathcal G_1\to\mathcal G_2$, $b_p(\ker\varphi)=\ker(b_p\varphi)$, both computed sectionwise. (The small etale sites are taken, as in the source, with set-sized underlying categories: Stacks, Topologies, Definition 021B, inside a chosen big etale site; the lemma needs this smallness.)

source.place: Lemma 021I (lemma-morphism-big-small-etale, line 1176), proof: $u$ commutes with fibre products and $u(S/S)=T/T$, so Sites Proposition 00X6 applies; sites.tex Lemma 00X3 (line 452) and the proof of Lemma 00X5 (line 2802): 'Because the categories $\mathcal I_Y^{opp}$ are filtered we see that $u_p$ commutes with finite limits'; sites.tex Lemma 00YT (line 10393) for abelian presheaves

proof.text: Left exactness. By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (clause 1, for the site $V_{\Et}$) the inclusion $\iota_V$ commutes with finite limits, and (clause 2, for the site $U_{\Et}$) the sheafification $\#:\mathrm{PAb}(U_{\Et})\to\Ab(U_{\Et})$ commutes with finite limits. By step 3 so does $b_p$. A composite of functors commuting with finite limits commutes with finite limits, and so does any functor naturally isomorphic to one that does; by step 1, $u^{-1}\cong\#\circ b_p\circ\iota_V$ commutes with finite limits. In particular $u^{-1}$ preserves kernels and the final (zero) object.

source.place: Lemma 00X5 (lemma-directed-morphism, line 2802), proof: 'since sheafification commutes with finite limits as well (Lemma 00WJ) we conclude because $u_s=\#\circ u_p$'; Lemma 00WJ (lemma-sheafification-exact, line 2134); sites-modules.tex Lemma 03CO(2) (limits of abelian sheaves are presheaf limits)

proof.text: Conclusion. By steps 2 and 4, $u^{-1}$ commutes with finite limits and finite colimits, i.e. it is exact. It preserves finite products, which in the additive categories $\Ab(V_{\Et})$, $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] are the finite direct sums, so it is additive; preserving kernels and cokernels, it carries a short exact sequence $0\to G'\to G\to G''\to0$ ($G'\to G$ a kernel of $G\to G''$, $G\to G''$ a cokernel of $G'\to G$) to a short exact sequence.

split_report.summary: Statement kept in substance and made explicit: 'morphism' now cites def-pc-scheme (a Mathlib leaf for schemes and their morphisms) instead of the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, the categories cite def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, and 'exact' is spelled out (finite limits and finite colimits, Stacks 0034). The imported one-step proof argued that the presheaf inverse image has a left and a right adjoint, which was not justified (a presheaf pullback u_p has no left adjoint in general, and none was constructed here) and cited 03Q1 as if it were a sheafification lemma; replaced by a five-step proof following Stacks 03Q1(1): u^{-1} = # o b_p o iota (Stacks 03Q0 formula, 00WX), right exactness from the reviewed lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-preserves-colimits, left exactness from the base-change functor commuting with finite limits (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits, Stacks 021D/021I), the presheaf pullback along such a functor commuting with finite limits (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-presheaf-pullback-left-exact, Stacks 00X3/00X5/00YT) and sheafification being exact with limits of sheaves sectionwise (new leaf lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact, Stacks 00WJ/03CO). def-weil-pbc-etale-site and def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves dropped from proof_deps (replaced by the precise nodes). Not a Mathlib leaf: Mathlib lacks continuity of MorphismProperty.Over.pullback for smallEtaleTopology, and its Lan finite-limit lemma needs small categories.
